Classify Schedule N filings into transaction types

Source: R/classify.R
classify_transactions.Rd

Applies rule-based labels to a filing-level feature table. The evidence columns are kept, so labels can be revised without re-running the pipeline.

Usage

classify_transactions(x, rules = merger_rules())

Arguments

x

A filing-level table, typically from sn_filings(), with these columns: HAS_P1, HAS_P2, LEADER_SN, N_NP_RECIP, TOP_SHARE, TOP_RECIP_EIN, and EIN2. Optional columns: LEADER_P7 (Part VII overlap), N_DONORS (dissolving donors to the same recipient in the window), R_NEW (recipient newly formed), FINAL_RETURN, and the corroborating-signal columns named in rules$corroborate. Missing optional columns are treated as FALSE (or 1 donor).

rules

A merger_rules() object.

Value

x (as a data.table) with added columns TERMINATED (the filer ended; see final_as_termination in merger_rules()), LEADER (leadership evidence), N_CORROBORATE (number of corroborating signals present), BASIS ("leader", "sn_text", "corroborated", or NA for non-mergers), and TYPE.
